title: Package Install Workflow
activity_flow: GUARD: check updateAllowList XOR updateMirrors — throw RuntimeException if both set
DECISION: lock file present? No → force update=true
DECISION: dryRun? Yes → set verbose, disable scripts/operations/writeLock/dumpAutoloader
ACTION: extractDevPackages (second solver pass for non-dev separation)
ACTION: verify lock file platform compatibility via Solver::solve
DECISION: lock incompatible / solver error? → return ERROR_LOCK_FILE_INVALID
ACTION: LocalRepoTransaction computes diff (locked vs installed)
ACTION: split operations into batches (composer-plugin with plugin-modifies-downloads first)
ACTION: for each install/update op → InstallerInterface::download(package) [async promise]
ACTION: split batch again: composer-plugin/composer-installer ops isolated
[No] → only output operation descriptions (dry run / no-execute path)
DECISION: dumpAutoloader=true? → AutoloadGenerator::dump(...) → generate autoload files
DECISION: strictPsrAutoloader AND PSR violations? → return ERROR_PSR_AUTOLOAD_VIOLATION
ACTION: check abandoned packages → io::writeError warnings
DECISION: auditConfig.audit=true? → Auditor::audit(packages) — return ERROR_AUDIT_FAILED on failure
key_relationships: Installer composes InstallationManager (calls execute, notifyInstalls, ensureBinariesPresence)
Installer composes EventDispatcher (dispatches script and installer events)
Installer uses Solver to resolve dependency graph (doUpdate/doInstall)
Installer uses Locker to read/write lock file
InstallationManager uses Loop to await async download promises
InstallationManager delegates to InstallerInterface per package type (download/prepare/install/update/uninstall/cleanup)
InstallationManager.execute → downloadAndExecuteBatch → executeBatch (nested batching for plugin ordering)
branching_conditions: update=true vs update=false: selects doUpdate or doInstall path
dryRun=true: disables operations, scripts, lock write, autoloader dump
downloadOnly=true: skips execution after downloads complete
executeOperations=true/false: controls whether InstallationManager.execute is called
lock file present (Locker::isLocked): triggers update fallback if absent
SolverProblemsException: error exit in both doUpdate and doInstall
package type == composer-plugin with plugin-modifies-downloads: isolated in its own batch first
package type == composer-plugin|composer-installer: isolated batch in executeBatch for activation ordering
auditConfig.audit=true: runs security audit at the end
important_notes: Installer::run() is the top-level entry point for both `composer install` and `composer update`. The run() method dispatches PRE_INSTALL_CMD/PRE_UPDATE_CMD at the start (before doUpdate/doInstall) and POST_INSTALL_CMD/POST_UPDATE_CMD at the end. InstallationManager::execute() uses ReactPHP promises for async parallel downloads (Loop::wait). Operations are batched twice: once in execute() to isolate download-modifying plugins, and again in downloadAndExecuteBatch() to isolate composer-plugin/composer-installer packages for correct activation order. The Solver runs once in doUpdate (full resolution) and optionally a second time in doInstall to verify lock file platform compatibility.
